title: Anti Offhand
description: This mod makes it so it removes any item put in your offhand, so it basically disables the use of the player's offhand.
body: This mod makes it so if the Player tries to use their Minecraft Offhand, their item will be deleted and removed from their Offhand, basically disabling the functionality of the Offhand from the game. This mod could be useful to people who want to disable/remove the functionality of the Offhand from Minecraft.
